evidence: Wilson, Flora Checklist of Northamptonshire (2014): Galanthus nivalis L., Snowdrop
terms.comment: Linnaeus’s name. galanthus is not in Lewis & Short and is left without marks of length; nivālis, snowy, is marked from it.

sources: Rob Wilson, A Flora Checklist of Northamptonshire & The Soke of Peterborough (2014), on the website of the Botanical Society of Britain and Ireland.
